document.abstract: Frederick M. Remley, Jr., who was Technical Director of Broadcast Services at the University of Michigan's Television Center for more than 20 years, was appointed Director of Michigan Media, the Television and Film Center of the University on January 1, 1982. From 1979 to 1981 he served as the SMPTE Vice-President for Television Affairs, and is now serving as the Vice-President for Educational Affairs for the 1982 1983 term.
